chapter.verse: Ka suahtak khit uh ciangin Malta tuikulh gam hi cih ka thei uh hi.
Guahzu a, khua dam ahih ciangin tua gam mite in mei cihin kote khempeuh pha takpi hong hehpih uh hi.
Paul in sing lom khat la a, mei tungah a khul lai takin gul khat in meikhu lak pan pusuakin Paul’ khut a tu hi.

Tua gam mite in gul in a khutah a om a muh uh ciangin, “Hih pa in mi thatpa ahi takpi zo hi. Tuipi launa pan a suahtak hangin a hin’ nadingin thuman in thu a pia kei hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kici uh hi.
Ahih hangin Paul in gul mei sungah singkhia a, bangmah natna thuak lo hi.

Ama pumpi khempeuh bawk ahi zongin, thakhatin pukin a si ding ahi zongin, tua mite in a sawt veipi a ngak uh hangin, ama tungah siatna khat beek piang lo a muh uh ciangin, a lungsim uh kikheel a, “Hih pa in pasian ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua mun pan kigamla lo Publias kici tuikulh gam sung hausapa a om hi. Tua hausapa in kote hong tung sak a, ni thum tawntung pha takpi-in hong vaak hi.
Publias’ pa in nattun leh gilsan vei-in a lum hi. Tua cinapa kiangah Paul in lut a, thu a nget khit ciangin a tungah a khut nga-in, cinatna a damsak hi.
Tua bang ahih ciangin tua tuikulh-a cina dangte hong pai uh a, damna a ngah uh hi.
Tua mite in lungdamna tampi hong pia uh a, teembaw tungah ka tuan’ kik uh ciangin ka sapnate uh teembaw tungah a koih uh hi.
Kha thum khit ciangin Ta Peeng milim a om, tua tuikulh gamah phalbi sung tawntung a khawl Alekzandria teembaw tungah ka tuang kik uh a,
Sirakhas khua tungin ni thum ka taam uh hi.
Tua san tak panin ka paikik uh ciangin kawi pai-in, Regium khua ka tung uh a, ni khat ka taam khit uh ciangin, khang lam pan huih nung a, ni nihin Puteoli khua ka tung uh hi.
Tua khua-ah ute naute tawh kimu-in, “Ni sagih sung hong taam un,” hong cih mah bangun ka taam khit uh ciangin, Rom khua-ah ka pai uh hi.

Rom khua-ah a om ute naute in kote paina thu a zak uh ciangin hong dawn ding kimkhatte in Appias Sumbuk dongin, kimkhatte in Mangbuk Thum dongin hong pai uh hi. Paul in tua mite a muh ciangin Pasian’ hehpihna phatin a lungdam uh hi.
Rom khua-ah ka tun’uh ciangin Paul in a cing galkap tawh a ut bangin a om theih na’ng thu a ngah hi.

Ni thum khit ciangin Paul in Judah mi upate a kikhopsak khit ciangin, “Ute naute aw, kei in Judah mite tung ahi zongin, i pute i pate’ ngeina tung ahi zongin, ka khial lo napi-in, Jerusalem khua mite in hong man uh a, Rom mite’ khut sungah hong pia uh hi.
Amaute in kei hong dot khit uh ciangin sih nading mawhna thu a muh loh uh ciangin, hong khah nuam uh hi.
Tua bang a deihna, Judah mite in a nial uh ciangin, Kaisar Kumpipa kiangah azukhan ding ka ngaihsun hi. Tua bang ka cihna in ka mi pawlte tungah mawhsak nading ka cihna ahi kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note mu-in, hong hopih dingin kong sam hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Israel pawlte’ lametna thu hangin hih sikkhau khihna ka thuak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mite in “Nang thu zaksakna lai Judah gam panin ka ngah kei uh hi. Tua gam pan a hong tung a, nangmah hong mawhsak ute naute kuamah a om kei hi.
Ahih hangin hih biakna in gam khempeuh ah kosiatna a thuak cih thei ka hih manun, na upna thu nangma kiang pan ka ngai nuam uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Kimuh nading ni a seh uh ciangin mi tampite in Paul’ omna-ah hong pai uh a, Paul in Pasian’ Gam thu teci pang a, tuate in Zeisu thu a up nadingun Moses’ Thukham lai leh Pasian’ kamsangte lai paulamin thu hilhin, zingsang akipan nitum dongin a zol hi.
Kimkhatte in Paul’ thu gen a um uh hi. Kimkhatte in a um kei uh hi.
Tua mah bangin khat leh khat thu kituak loin, Paul in thu khat a gen khit ciangin a paikhia uh hi. Paul in, “Kha Siangtho in kamsangpa Isaiah tungah na pute na pate kiang uh ah a kituakin a gen hi.
‘Pai in la, hih mite tungah hih bangin ci in, zaza napi tel lo; mumu napi thei lo,

Amaute in a mit uh tawh a muh loh nading, a bil uh tawh a zak loh nading, A lungsim uh tawh thu a theihtel loh nading, amaute kihei-in damna a ngah loh nadingun, amau lungsim uh mawl a, amau bil uh ngong a, a mit uh a si hi,’ a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in hong piak hih gupna thu Gentailte kiangah kipuak ding a,
amaute in zong a sang ding uh hi ci-in note in thei ta un,” ci-in a gen hi.
Paul in kum nih tawntung a sap innah om a, ama kiangah a pai khempeuh tung sak hi.
Nawngkaina khat beek om loin, nop takin Pasian’ Gam thu gen a, Topa Zeisu Khazih’ thu a hilh hi.
